title: ContentTaxonomyTermRelationshipType - Data API
description: Represents the type of relationship between two terms in a content taxonomy. This object is available in API version 63.0 and later.

ContentTaxonomyTrmRelaCatg.description: Category of the relationship type. Possible values are: HasBroader

special_access_rules: To view this object, users need the permission View Content Taxonomy enabled.
usage: ContentTaxonomyRelationshipType can’t be created, updated, or deleted. In API version 63.0, the default category for the relationship type is HasBroader.
